description: The exploded views of an assembly.

title.description: The document's title as SOLIDWORKS shows it.

path.description: The full path, absent while the document has never been saved.

dirty.description: True when the document has unsaved changes.

visible.description: False for a document SOLIDWORKS loaded only because an open assembly uses it: it has no window of its own.

items.description: An exploded view of an assembly.

name.description: Its name, for example Exploded View1.

exploded.description: True when the assembly shows it exploded now.

items.description: A step of an exploded view, as SOLIDWORKS holds it.

name.description: Its name, for example Explode Step1.

components.description: The names of the components it moves.

distance_mm.description: How far it moves them, mm.

angle_deg.description: How far it turns them, degrees; absent when it does not turn them.

reversed.description: True when it goes against the direction it was given.

steps.description: Its steps, in order; absent for a view of a configuration that is not active, whose steps SOLIDWORKS gives only while it is shown.

empty.description: True when it has no steps: what explode.delete or a rolled-back explode.create leaves on SOLIDWORKS 2026 SP4, whose API cannot delete a view. Absent when its steps were not read.

exploded.description: The view shown exploded now; absent when the assembly is collapsed.
